title.en: Control charts for variables: X̄ and R charts
title.kn: ಚರಗಳಿಗೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು: X̄ ಮತ್ತು R ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು

heading.en: Watching the average and the spread

hook.en: A machine cuts steel rods to 44 mm. Every hour an inspector measures five rods. The average tells us if the machine has drifted; the range tells us if it has become shaky. The X̄ and R charts watch both.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಯಂತ್ರ ಉಕ್ಕಿನ ಸರಳುಗಳನ್ನು 44 ಮಿಮೀ ಗೆ ಕತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಗಂಟೆ ಐದು ಸರಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರಾಸರಿ ಯಂತ್ರ ಸರಿದಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು, ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಅಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. X̄ ಮತ್ತು R ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಗಮನಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Compute X̿ and R̄ from sample data
Find control limits of X̄ and R charts using A₂, D₃, D₄
Draw the charts and interpret them

narration.en: A machine cuts steel rods to 44 mm. Every hour an inspector measures five rods. The average tells us if the machine has drifted; the range tells us if it has become shaky. The X̄ and R charts watch both.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಯಂತ್ರ ಉಕ್ಕಿನ ಸರಳುಗಳನ್ನು 44 ಮಿಮೀ ಗೆ ಕತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಗಂಟೆ ಐದು ಸರಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರಾಸರಿ ಯಂತ್ರ ಸರಿದಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು, ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಅಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. X̄ ಮತ್ತು R ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಗಮನಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Take $k$ samples of size $n$; find each sample mean $\bar{x}$ and range $R$. Then $\bar{\bar{X}} = \dfrac{\sum \bar{x}}{k}$ and $\bar{R} = \dfrac{\sum R}{k}$. Control limits for the X̄ chart: $CL = \bar{\bar{X}}$, $UCL = \bar{\bar{X}} + A_2\bar{R}$, $LCL = \bar{\bar{X}} - A_2\bar{R}$, where $A_2$ depends on $n$ (for $n = 4$, $A_2 = 0.729$; for $n = 5$, $A_2 = 0.577$).
body.kn: k ಮಾದರಿಗಳ ಸರಾಸರಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಗಳಿಂದ X̿ ಮತ್ತು R̄. X̄ ನಕ್ಷೆ: CL = X̿, UCL = X̿ + A₂R̄, LCL = X̿ − A₂R̄; A₂ ನಮೂನೆ ಗಾತ್ರ n ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿತ.

narration.en: Take k samples of size n; find each sample mean x-bar and range R. Then X = dfracsum x-bark and R = dfracsum Rk. Control limits for the X̄ chart: CL = X, UCL = X + A_2R, LCL = X - A_2R, where A_2 depends on n (for n = 4, A_2 = 0.729; for n = 5, A_2 = 0.577).
narration.kn: k ಮಾದರಿಗಳ ಸರಾಸರಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಗಳಿಂದ X̿ ಮತ್ತು R̄. X̄ ನಕ್ಷೆ: CL = X̿, UCL = X̿ + A₂R̄, LCL = X̿ − A₂R̄; A₂ ನಮೂನೆ ಗಾತ್ರ n ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿತ.

narration.en: The teacher computes the limits from ten samples of five rods and plots the ten means.

say.en: Ten samples of size 5. The means add to 442 and the ranges to 58. So X double bar is 44.2 and R bar is 5.8.
With A2 equal to 0.577, the limits are 44.2 plus or minus 3.35.
Draw the central line and the two limits.
Plot the ten sample means and join them.
Samples 2, 3, 6 and 7 fall outside the limits. The process mean is out of control.

body.en: The R chart controls variability: $CL = \bar{R}$, $UCL = D_4\bar{R}$, $LCL = D_3\bar{R}$, with constants from tables (for $n = 5$: $D_3 = 0$, $D_4 = 2.114$; for $n = 4$: $D_3 = 0$, $D_4 = 2.282$). Draw the R chart first: if variability is out of control, the X̄ limits (which use $\bar{R}$) are not reliable.
body.kn: R ನಕ್ಷೆ ಚಂಚಲತೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: CL = R̄, UCL = D₄R̄, LCL = D₃R̄. n = 5 ಗೆ D₃ = 0, D₄ = 2.114.

points.en: CL = R̄; UCL = D₄R̄; LCL = D₃R̄
Check the R chart before the X̄ chart

narration.en: The R chart controls variability: CL = R, UCL = D_4R, LCL = D_3R, with constants from tables (for n = 5: D_3 = 0, D_4 = 2.114; for n = 4: D_3 = 0, D_4 = 2.282). Draw the R chart first: if variability is out of control, the X̄ limits (which use R) are not reliable.
narration.kn: R ನಕ್ಷೆ ಚಂಚಲತೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: CL = R̄, UCL = D₄R̄, LCL = D₃R̄. n = 5 ಗೆ D₃ = 0, D₄ = 2.114.

caption.en: X̄ chart limits for samples of size 5 (A₂ = 0.577). Slide X̿ and R̄; the lines show CL, UCL and LCL over 10 samples.

narration.en: Change the average range and watch the limits open out or close in. The central line moves only with X double bar.

tryThis.en: Double R̄. How much wider is the X̄ band?
Which sample means from the example are outside?
Why is the LCL of the R chart zero for n = 5?

problem.en: For the ten samples of size 5 above (ranges 5, 6, 5, 7, 7, 4, 8, 6, 4, 6), draw conclusions from the R chart (D₃ = 0, D₄ = 2.114).

steps.en: The largest range is 8 < 12.26: all points are inside.
Variability is in control, but the X̄ chart showed the mean is not.

answer.en: R chart in control; X̄ chart out of control

narration.en: Let us work this out together. For the ten samples of size 5 above (ranges 5, 6, 5, 7, 7, 4, 8, 6, 4, 6), draw conclusions from the R chart (D₃ = 0, D₄ = 2.114).

heading.en: A for averages, D for dispersion

body.en: A₂ goes with the X̄ chart (Averages); D₃ and D₄ go with the R chart (Dispersion). Lower constant (D₃) for the lower limit, higher (D₄) for the upper.

narration.en: A for averages, D for dispersion. A₂ goes with the X̄ chart (Averages); D₃ and D₄ go with the R chart (Dispersion). Lower constant (D₃) for the lower limit, higher (D₄) for the upper.

points.en: R chart: D₃R̄ to D₄R̄, centre R̄.
points.kn: R ನಕ್ಷೆ: D₃R̄ ರಿಂದ D₄R̄, ಕೇಂದ್ರ R̄.

points.en: X̄ controls the level; R controls the spread.

homework.en: Draw the X̄ and R charts for the example data on graph paper and comment.

narration.en: Recap. X̿ = Σx̄/k, R̄ = ΣR/k. X̄ chart: X̿ ± A₂R̄. R chart: D₃R̄ to D₄R̄, centre R̄. X̄ controls the level; R controls the spread.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. X̿ = Σx̄/k, R̄ = ΣR/k. X̄ ನಕ್ಷೆ: X̿ ± A₂R̄. R ನಕ್ಷೆ: D₃R̄ ರಿಂದ D₄R̄, ಕೇಂದ್ರ R̄. X̄ ಮಟ್ಟವನ್ನು, R ಹರಡುವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.
